summary: HNO International filed an 8-K/A correcting an omission from a prior 8-K filed May 8, 2026. The amendment adds disclosure of a separate securities purchase agreement, a convertible promissory note, and a warrant with Lambda Ventures, LLC, entered on May 5, 2026, alongside a similar existing arrangement with Monroe Street Capital Partners. These are routine financing transactions with accredited investors. Terms: $67,500 principal, 385,000 warrant shares. No board recommendation or special-situation catalysts are present. This filing merely completes prior disclosure; no special situation arises.
